label: AI Insight UI — Data Products
info:
Data Products subflow per FAP §10. The catalogue is REAL: it enumerates
tables actually present in Trino's `gold` schema via
`SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'gold'`,
then overlays descriptive metadata (semanticScope, description, domain) for
the tables we know about. A table that exists in gold but isn't in the
descriptive overlay still appears in the response with `description: null`
and `domain: 'unclassified'` rather than being silently dropped.

Actions:
  data-products.list             — every gold table
  data-products.detail (id)      — single product manifest (looks up id in the
                                   live information_schema.tables result)
  data-products.energy.list      — domain = energy
  data-products.city.list        — domain = city

FAP §10 (responsibility subflow) + §12 (explicit success/failure: a Trino
failure surfaces as errors.integration, never a synthesised catalogue).

name: data-products.* — query gold catalogue + overlay metadata
